messages:
kai: Heads up planning a 7-week remote stint in Reykjavik Aug 1Aug 21. Need to confirm payroll, WFH stipend proration, health coverage, and whether shipping laptop is allowed. Also any tax/nexus risk?

rebecca-peopleops: Short answers: manager sign-off + short-term remote form required. <90 days usually stays on US payroll but we confirm with payroll/legal. Stipend prorated monthly.

noah-payroll: We don't run payroll in Iceland. For <=90 days we keep US payroll if addendum signed and return travel documented. Stipend paid in USD on paystub and taxed normally.

legal-bot: Iceland has specific personal services rules; 7 weeks is low risk but depends on client interactions. We'll do counsel check; avoid local contracting or hiring while there.

emma: I approve, as long as Kai keeps 3 hours overlap with PST core and documents on-call coverage.

sam: Equipment: we prefer you travel with company laptop. Shipping internationally flagged for customs/warranty. We can reimburse local peripherals with receipts.

kai: Thanks all. Two quicks: 1) Is coworking reimbursable? 2) Does international medical cover island emergencies?

rebecca-peopleops: Coworking generally not included in standard WFH stipend; exceptions by approval. Ping benefits@ with dates for coverage check.

noah-payroll: Reimbursements via Expensify tag Remote-Travel. Stipend shown on US paystub.

legal-bot: Counsel ticket opened; expect 3 business days. If flagged, options: shorten trip or restrict external-facing work.

kai: Filing form now  thanks!
